text:
the editing techniques and styles you thought were unattainable

now just one reference prompt away:

- the hook from an Instagram reel
- the b-roll style from a TikTok
- the captions from a YouTube Short

then automatically apply them to your footage with your story

get started ↓

California VLOG, mostly LA :) 

Prompt: 
15-second high-energy California travel vlog starring an extremely beautiful playful sensual Japanese girl. Fast-paced multi-shot edit, trendy Gen-Z travel influencer aesthetic, cinematic handheld vlog energy, vibrant California sunlight, youthful chaotic fun, premium TikTok/Reels editing style.

IMPORTANT:
Keep her appearance and outfits consistent with the reference images:
• long black hair
• slim curvy body
• soft natural makeup
• playful bright smile
• youthful sensual energy

MAIN OUTFITS (consistent across scenes):
LOOK 1:
black triangle bikini top, oversized loose white button-up shirt worn open, light blue denim shorts, delicate necklace, casual California beach aesthetic

LOOK 2:
white cropped tank top, light gray high-waisted leggings, sporty influencer vibe

LOOK 3:
white strapless tube top with loose white sweatpants and black sunglasses

VIDEO STYLE:
• fast cuts every 1–2 seconds
• no slow motion
• energetic handheld camera
• realistic vlog movement
• natural hair physics and clothing movement
• authentic sunlight and shadows
• playful travel influencer behavior
• dynamic camera whip transitions
• high-vibes summer energy
• realistic environment physics
• subtle lens flares
• social-media luxury aesthetic

AUDIO:
Upbeat female-fronted indie rock song with driving drums and electric guitar. Ambient California city sounds underneath. Opening includes soft ASMR whisper close to microphone.

OPENING HOOK (0:00–0:02):
Extreme close-up selfie angle while walking on Hollywood Walk of Fame. She leans close to camera and whispers softly in ASMR:
“California with me today?”
She smiles mischievously and immediately pulls camera away into fast transition.

SHOT SEQUENCE:

0:02–0:04
Hollywood sign overlook. Wearing white crop top and gray leggings. Wind blowing through her hair naturally while she turns toward the camera smiling.

0:04–0:05
Fast rollercoaster POV shot. Wearing black bikini top and open white shirt. Laughing wildly as wind hits her face.

0:05–0:07
Disneyland castle background. She spins playfully while holding the edges of her oversized white shirt. Bright sunlight, energetic tourists around her.

0:07–0:09
Walking through Beverly Hills in denim shorts and fitted white crop top. Sunglasses on. Confident influencer walk. Quick hair flip toward camera.

0:09–0:11
Venice Beach palms and sand. She pauses, smiles at the ocean breeze, shirt flowing naturally in the wind.

0:11–0:13
Golden Gate Bridge overlook. Wearing sporty white crop top and gray leggings. Camera circles around her as she leans on railing looking at the water.

0:13–0:15
Santa Monica Pier at sunset. She walks toward camera laughing, grabs the camera playfully with one hand, then final fast whip-pan ending on palm-tree-lined California street.

COLOR & LOOK:
Golden California sunlight, vibrant blue skies, dreamy summer glow, cinematic travel vlog grading, social-media luxury aesthetic, realistic skin texture, natural body motion, energetic editing rhythm.

NEGATIVE:
No slow motion, no stiff movement, no duplicate people, no unrealistic physics, no floating hair, no uncanny facial animation, no anime style.
